mnemonic: A Shopper Rushes to Yell 'sold!' after buying. SH-R-Y is the root of buying.
example: She اشترى a new bag, and her شراء habit means she يشتري often.

mnemonic: A Driver Fumbles with the Payment machine, pushing the button. D-F-ʿ is the root of paying and pushing.
example: He دفع the bill in one دفعة, and it stayed مدفوع.

mnemonic: An Artist Tosses a Yellow gift to a friend. ʿ-Ṭ-Y is the root of giving.
example: He أعطى a gift kindly, and his عطاء never stops as he يعطي often.

mnemonic: A Racer Bags the Honor of winning first place. R-B-Ḥ is the root of profit and winning.
example: The trader ربح a fortune, and every deal يربح makes him a رابح.

mnemonic: A Knight Sighs and Retreats after losing the battle. KH-S-R is the root of losing.
example: He خسر the match, and the خسارة still stings as he يخسر again.

mnemonic: A Zoologist Rakes and Aerates the soil to plant seeds. Z-R-ʿ is the root of planting and farming.
example: The farmer زرع the field, his زراعة thriving on the مزرعة.

mnemonic: A Thespian Munches a Ripe fruit on stage. TH-M-R is the root of fruit and results.
example: The tree ثمر sweet apples, and every ثمرة among the ثمار was ripe.

mnemonic: A Hiker Secures the Loot he was after. Ḥ-Ṣ-L is the root of obtaining and resulting.
example: He حصل on the prize, since he يحصل on rewards through hard work.

mnemonic: A Hiker Tugs at his Aching Joints, needing rest badly. The extended root Ḥ-T-ʾ-J (from ح و ج) means to need.
example: He احتاج help urgently, and his حاجة grows as he يحتاج more.

mnemonic: A Knight Delivers a Meal in service to the king. KH-D-M is the root of serving.
example: The خادم خدم the guests well, his خدمة praised by all.
